name: street_legal
title: Wrench Works: Street Legal
tagline: From a junkyard wreck to the ROC, on West Coast USA or Valo City
description: A career in the spirit of Street Legal Racing: Redline. Start with no car, buy one at the junkyard, build it in your garage, race the city's street racers at night for money and pink slips, and climb through the garages to the ROC. Needs Wrench Works. Plays on West Coast USA, or on the Wrench Works: Valo City map when installed.
author: Connor Moyle
